1.hint: 1. Create your GitHub account (browser) - echo "GitHub account created: YOUR_USERNAME"

2.hint: 2. Create a private repository (browser) - echo "Private repo git-practice created, empty, no README"

3.hint: Generate the key: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "you@example.com"`, Enter at every prompt.

4.hint: 3. Generate an SSH key on your server - cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub

5.check: ssh -T -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new git@github.com 2>&1 | grep -q 'successfully authenticated'
5.hint: Add the PUBLIC key to GitHub (Settings -> SSH and GPG keys), then `ssh -T git@github.com`.

6.hint: 6. Connect your repo to GitHub - cd ~/git-practice

7.check: git -C /home/ec2-user/git-practice remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null | grep -q github.com
7.hint: Connect the repo: `git remote add origin git@github.com:YOUR_USERNAME/git-practice.git`.
7.done: origin points at your GitHub repo

8.hint: 6. Connect your repo to GitHub - git remote -v

10.hint: Push the tag: `git push origin v1.0`.

11.hint: 9. The pull request cycle - change control for DBAs - git switch -c add-backup-runbook

12.hint: 9. The pull request cycle - change control for DBAs - vi backup-runbook.md

13.hint: 9. The pull request cycle - change control for DBAs - # Backup Runbook - pg-git-1 ;  ; 1. Check latest base backup ; 2. Ver

14.hint: 9. The pull request cycle - change control for DBAs - git add backup-runbook.md

15.hint: On branch add-backup-runbook, create backup-runbook.md and commit it.

16.hint: Push the branch: `git push -u origin add-backup-runbook`.
16.done: the branch is on GitHub - open the PR in your browser

17.hint: 10. Open and merge the pull request (browser) - echo "PR merged on GitHub"

18.hint: 11. Pull the merge back to the server - git switch main

19.check: test -f /home/ec2-user/git-practice/backup-runbook.md && git -C /home/ec2-user/git-practice log --oneline -3 2>/dev/null | grep -qi 'merge pull request'
19.hint: After merging the PR on GitHub: `git switch main` then `git pull`.
19.done: the PR merge is on your server

20.hint: 11. Pull the merge back to the server - git log --oneline | head -3
